jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Marcomm Program Manager is a critical operational role within the Corporate Marketing & Communications team, reporting to the Vice President of Corporate Marketing & Communications. This role serves the entire marcomm function — spanning brand, B2B/corporate marketing/product/client marketing, and content — as its dedicated operational backbone. The Marcomm PM will establish and run a clear cross-functional operating rhythm, and prioritization cadence that brings consistency, visibility, and accountability to how the team plans and delivers work against its most important growth initiatives. By owning the systems and workflows that keep integrated marketing moving, this role directly enables senior marketers to stay focused on high-value strategy and the work that most influences pipeline, retention, and win rate.

Responsibilities

Own and operate the marcomm team's intake process — creating a single point of entry for all new project requests across corporate marketing, client marketing, brand, and content — ensuring each request is scoped, prioritized, and routed appropriately before work begins.
Plug into and reinforce the broader Growth team's existing operating rhythms and reporting structures — rather than standing up marcomm-specific systems in isolation — adapting shared cadences (e.g., weekly prioritization reviews, sprint-style planning, status syncs) to create consistent visibility into active work, dependencies, and capacity across marcomm teams.
Help to develop and manage integrated project plans, timelines, and delivery schedules in Asana, keeping all workstreams current and surfacing blockers before they become delays.
Produce clear, concise status reporting for marketing leadership — replacing fragmented Slack threads and ad hoc follow-up with structured, repeatable updates that make progress and priorities legible at a glance.
Serve as the connective tissue across marcomm teams — facilitating coordination between Corporate Communications, Client Marketing, Creative, and Content — so that cross-functional dependencies are tracked and hand-offs are clean.
Proactively identify risks, resource conflicts, and scope creep; escalate to the VP or relevant senior marketers with recommended resolutions.
Support program-level prioritization decisions by maintaining a shared view of the team's portfolio, flagging capacity constraints, and helping leadership make informed trade-off calls.
Contribute to the development of lightweight, scalable standard operating procedures and workflow documentation that reduce reliance on tribal knowledge and informal communication channels.
Partner with senior marketers on campaign and initiative scoping to ensure timelines are realistic, resources are aligned, and deliverables are clearly defined before execution begins.
Drive adoption of Asana and shared project management practices across the marcomm team, providing guidance and accountability to ensure consistent use.
Spearhead and advance key technology transformation initiatives on behalf of the marcomm team — translating FY27 plan milestones into actionable, repeatable execution plans in close partnership with Growth and Tech counterparts, ensuring marcomm stays aligned and moving in lockstep with broader organizational transformation efforts.
Partner with marcomm leadership to foster a strong sense of team culture, engagement, and continuous learning — creating consistent, meaningful touchpoints for employees and sub-teams that reinforce connection, shared purpose, and professional growth across the function.

Requirements

3–5 years of experience in program management, marketing operations, or a traffic/production coordination role, ideally within an in-house marketing team or agency environment.
Demonstrated experience building or improving intake and workflow systems in a fast-moving, matrixed organization.
Proficiency with Asana or a comparable project management platform; comfort configuring projects, templates, and dashboards to support team-wide visibility.
Strong organizational skills and a systems-oriented mindset — you find it genuinely satisfying to bring structure to ambiguous, high-velocity environments.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex workstreams into clear, executive-ready status updates.
Experience facilitating cross-functional coordination across multiple teams and stakeholders simultaneously.
Ability to manage competing priorities without losing sight of what matters most; comfortable asking clarifying questions and pushing back constructively when scope or timelines are unclear.
Comfort operating in an environment undergoing process and tooling transformation — you are a change enabler, not a change resistor.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting B2B or enterprise marketing teams, with exposure to demand generation, client marketing, or content marketing workflows.
Familiarity with healthcare, tech, or highly regulated industries.
PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent project management certification.

Summary

Maryland Care Management, Inc. is searching for an innovative Social Worker located in Maryland who is a self-starter with a problem-solving mindset. In this role, you will work directly with MPC members to address social barriers to optimal health care while providing care management through a cooperative process of assessment, planning, and facilitation. You will also act as a member advocate when referring options and community services to meet members’ health needs.

About Maryland Care Management, Inc. (MCMI)

Maryland Care Management, Inc. (MCMI) manages Maryland Physician Care's (MPC) statewide provider network of hospitals and physicians. Maryland Physicians Care has been providing services to the HealthChoice Medicaid populations since 1996, and we are proud of our footprint in the community. With over 230,000 members, MPC consistently has been one of MD's largest Medicaid-managed care organizations.

Why join us?

MCMI recognizes the importance of flexibility and offers multiple work arrangements. Along with competitive pay, we offer excellent benefits (medical, dental, and vision plans, 100% employer Term Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability, 401k Employer Match up to 4%) as well as 20 days of PTO, and tuition assistance/professional development plans.

Your future colleagues at MCMI are welcoming, friendly, and eager to help each other succeed. We are committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, providing organizational-wide social opportunities, and constantly improving our ongoing efforts to positively impact our members' lives.

What You’ll Do

Utilizes clinical judgment to assess members, prioritizing emerging issues to maintain a member-centric approach.
Collaborates with interdisciplinary care team to aid member health goals via case rounds and consultation.
Utilizes problem-solving skills to research and identify community resources and coordinate referral mechanisms.
Plans specific goals and actions designed to meet the member’s needs as identified in the assessment process that are action-oriented, time-specific, and cost-effective.
Builds strong relationships with members by aiding and advocating to help achieve health goals and through visits to the home and community, telephonic and/or video conferencing.
Monitors care management activities, services, and members’ responses to interventions, to track the effectiveness of the plan of care and the utilization of services.
Participates in outreach activities to promote knowledge of the program and its services and to coordinate program activities with outside community agencies and health care providers.
Hybrid position. Must be available and willing to travel up to 50% of the time to meet with members.

What We’re Looking For

Knowledge of community agencies and resources. (PG/MOCO/St. Mary's/Calvert/Charles)
Working knowledge of multi-system outreach programs related to health care delivery, clinical education, and health-related services.

Required Education and Work Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in social work.
Valid Maryland state LMSW or LCSW licensure (in good standing).
3 years of experience in a community setting.
Possession of a valid Maryland State Driver’s License.

Preferred Education And Work Experience

Knowledge of government Managed Care programs (Medicaid/Medicare)
Master’s degree in social work

Touchstone Recovery Center
is hiring a Certified Substance Use Disorder Counselor
to support exciting growth in our organization. Touchstone
is a leading provider of comprehensive outpatient services for individuals struggling with substance use disorders. Our multidisciplinary team of professionals is dedicated to delivering personalized care, evidence-based treatments, and compassionate support to help clients achieve lasting recovery and improved well-being.
